LESSON: STORAGE OF CROP PRODUCE (PREPARING STORAGE STRUCTURES FOR CROPS, MANAGE STORED CROP PRODUCE)

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 9
Subject: AGRICULTURE FOR LEARNERS WITH HEARING IMPAIRMENT
Strand: FOOD PRODUCTION PROCESSES
Topic 2.2: Storage of crop produce (preparing storage structures for crops, manage stored crop produce)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 10

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Storage of crop produce (preparing storage structures for crops, manage stored crop produce), part of FOOD PRODUCTION PROCESSES in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 9 AGRICULTURE FOR LEARNERS WITH HEARING IMPAIRMENT.

Key inquiry question: how to prepare an existing storage structure or facility 1. How can we prepare a facility in readiness for storage of crop produce?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. sign words related to ways of preparing storage structures of crop produce,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Storage of crop produce (preparing storage structures for crops, manage stored crop produce) in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Storage of crop produce (preparing storage structures for crops, manage stored crop produce) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Critical thinking and problem solving: open-mindedness and creativity skills are developed as learners prepare storage structure

and manage crop produce to maintain quality and reduce post-harvest loss.

● Communication and collaboration: self-expression and listening skills are developed as learners discuss on preparation of a store

structure for storage of food.

Values:
● Responsibility: as learners manage hygiene of the school food store.

● Unity: as learners play team roles in preparation of a food store.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
● Food safety and security: as learners address wastage of crop produce through use of proper storage structures.
